items.title: Multiple web server 400 error codes from same source ip on intranet-server from 172.19.131.174
items.reference: On 24 Jan 2022 from 03:56 to 04:00 UTC, 172.19.131.174 scanned the intranet web server: 550 alerts for multiple 400 error codes from the same source on intranet-server port 80, together with Nmap user-agent detections, sshd scan attempts and requests for forbidden files. This is web reconnaissance (MITRE T1595.002) during the dirb and wpscan phases. Severity is critical; block 172.19.131.174 and review the exposed web paths.

The activity came from 172.19.131.174 (596 alerts), 192.168.230.122 (17 alerts), 172.19.130.4 (6 alerts) and 3 more. Severity is Critical (max Wazuh level 10; MITRE T1595.002, T1021.004, T1055, T1190, T1083 - Lateral Movement, Reconnaissance, Defense Evasion, Privilege Escalation and 2 more) in attack phase(s) service_scans, wpscan, dirb, cracking. Recommended action: Block or rate-limit the scanning IP at the firewall/WAF and check the web server for exposed or vulnerable paths (directory brute-forcing / WordPress scanning).
